svg.title: The 10 busiest deep-draft ports take 44% of large-ship port visits; the other 63 share the rest

cc:Work.dc:title: The 10 busiest deep-draft ports take 44% of large-ship port visits; the other 63 share the rest
cc:Work.dc:description: Packed circles, one per deep-draft port, sized by large-ship port visits and colored by coast; Galveston, New Orleans, and Plaquemines are the largest circles, and dozens of small circles ring them.
